title: Miso Butter Tacos
description: Japanese miso butter meets a Mexican taco night: roasted sweet potatoes glazed in salty-sweet miso butter, tucked into warm corn tortillas with lime cabbage.

ingredients.name: Sweet potatoes
ingredients.note: about 500 g, peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes

ingredients.name: Limes
ingredients.note: one juiced, one cut into wedges

steps.title: Roast the sweet potatoes
steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Toss the sweet potato cubes with the oil and a pinch of salt on a baking sheet and roast for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until browned at the edges and tender.

steps.title: Make the miso butter
steps.instruction: Mash the white miso into the softened butter with the soy sauce until smooth. Taste: it should be salty, rich and a little sweet.

steps.title: Glaze the potatoes
steps.instruction: As soon as the tray comes out of the oven, add the miso butter and toss so it melts over the hot potatoes and coats every cube.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.instruction: Heat a dry skillet over medium-high heat and warm the corn tortillas for 20–30 seconds a side until pliable and lightly spotted. Keep them wrapped in a clean towel.

steps.title: Assemble the tacos
steps.instruction: Toss the cabbage with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt. Fill each tortilla with miso-butter potatoes, a handful of cabbage, cilantro, scallion and sesame seeds. Serve with lime wedges.
